data.description:
Trade compliance represents one of the most intense aspects of engaging in international trade, and failure to maintain it leads to multiple negative consequences of non-compliance. Those consequences can include hefty monetary fines, civil penalties, and seized shipments.

Effective trade compliance ensures that goods are classified correctly, and the origin and valuation of goods are accurately declared according to the laws, sanctions, and regulations.

You must also ensure that the appropriate duties and taxes are paid. However, this is only a tiny part of the bigger picture.

The next time you ask yourself how vital trade compliance is, think about what would happen if your company could not ship any product to any foreign destination!

An effective trade compliance professional protects the company and country from any potential danger.

The Professional Diploma in International Trade Compliance aims to educate existing and aspiring international trade professionals around the world. We offer the most current and practical education and training on all aspects of international trade; compliance and regulations - taught by Trade compliance professional experts. Our training focuses on the practical side of business to ensure that our learners are adequately supported and skilled to kick start or enhance their career opportunities and growth.

This foundation course takes you through the concepts of International commercial terms, emphasizing the existing eleven types of International Commercial Terms – Incoterms 2020it includes the use of each incoterm in different modes of transport, its suitable for all to have a clear understanding of the procedures required to ensure to apply the appropriate Incoterm.
Incoterms are widely used but often misunderstood within international trade. They can impact on several areas of a business including sales, accounts, shipping, operations, compliance, and customer service. If used correctly, they can help you to avoid uncertainty, minimize delays and facilitate smooth operations, transport, and payment.
An introduction to Incoterms and their importance to international trade. Understand the history and purpose of Incoterms, how they are used, the practical issues to be considered, as well as practical topics such why EXW is not suitable for international trade.
An understanding of Incoterms is fundamental to international trade. Our training focuses on our learners are adequately supported and skilled to have a clear understanding of the procedures required to ensure to apply the appropriate Incoterm in international trade.
The problem with international trade contracts is that they end up having different meanings in different countries with respect to obligation of the seller and the buyer in the form of unanticipated disputes occur, the parties get stuck, to help avoid misunderstanding between the parties to these contracts as well as promote uniformity in law, the International Chamber of Commerce (ICC) has published INCOTERMS.
Contracts for the international sale of goods should indicate the terms of sale, preferable with one of the 11 incoterms.

## What makes this course different

This course provides a comprehensive understanding of the INCOTERMS 2020 rules, which are internationally recognized terms used in international trade contracts. The course focuses on the assessment test and certification of participants, ensuring they have a thorough knowledge of the INCOTERMS 2020 rules and their application in real-world scenarios.

Throughout the course, participants will learn about the various terms and conditions that govern the responsibilities and obligations of buyers and sellers in international trade. They will gain an in-depth understanding of the latest changes and updates introduced in the INCOTERMS 2020 edition.

The course is designed to equip learners with the necessary skills to effectively apply the INCOTERMS 2020 rules in their daily business operations. Learners will have the opportunity to enhance their knowledge through practical exercises, case studies, and interactive discussions.

Students pursuing degrees or courses in international trade, logistics, or related fields, who want to supplement their theoretical knowledge with practical insights into export documentation and procedures.

It is important to note that the course can cater to individuals with varying levels of expertise, from beginners to those with some prior knowledge of export documentation.

The course can serve as a valuable resource for anyone seeking a comprehensive understanding of export documentation and procedures, regardless of their industry or profession.

data.description:
## Who We Are

4PL Academy is the education and training arm of 4PL Consultancy Ltd, dedicated to developing industry-ready professionals across logistics, global trade compliance, supply chain management, marketing, and AI technology through immersive, real-world learning.


4PL Consultancy Ltd, a UK-based firm with a strong presence in India, specialises in logistics, supply chain, and global trade compliance. We partner with organisations to simplify operations, ensure regulatory compliance, and optimise performance across global markets.


Our close collaboration with industry revealed a critical gap — the shortage of job-ready talent. In response, we established 4PL Academy to integrate industry expertise with education, creating programs that prepare individuals to perform from day one.


By bridging the gap between industry and workforce development, we are committed to creating real, measurable impact for both students and organisations.

From Learning to Leading — Built for the Real World.


## Our Areas of Expertise

We combine deep industry expertise with workforce development to deliver practical and scalable solutions.


## Consulting & Industry Solutions

- Logistics and supply chain operations
- Trade compliance (HS Code, COO, ECCN, GTS)
- Process optimisation and outsourcing
- Technology-led operational solutions

## Workforce Development

- Industry-aligned training programs
- Skill development for real-world roles
- Academic collaborations and capability building

## How We Work

Our approach is built around practical execution, technology integration, and delivering measurable results.


Focus on practical, real-world outcomes

Use technology and AI in everyday operations

Deliver solutions that create measurable impact

We believe that knowledge is only valuable when it can be applied effectively.


## Operating Across Borders

With headquarters in the UK and operational teams in India, 4PL Consultancy combines global expertise with strong execution capabilities.


This allows us to:


- Support international clients
- Navigate cross-border trade environments
- Deliver scalable and efficient solutions

## Our Vision

To become a global leader in integrating industry expertise with workforce development.


## Our Mission

- To simplify global logistics and trade compliance
- To build industry-ready talent
- To create long-term value for businesses and individuals

## Why 4PL Consultancy

We combine deep industry expertise with a strong execution approach to deliver measurable and long-term impact.


Deep expertise in logistics and trade compliance

Strong industry network and partnerships

Technology-driven approach with AI integration

Proven consulting and execution capability

Commitment to quality, ethics, and long-term impact

## Leadership Perspective

At 4PL Consultancy, we believe that success lies in the ability to connect knowledge with real-world application.


Our focus has always been on creating meaningful impact — for businesses, partners, and individuals building their careers.


## Enabling Growth Through Expertise

From consulting to capability building, 4PL Consultancy continues to deliver solutions that are practical, scalable, and future-ready.

## University Alliance program

4PL Academy connects universities, students and industry through the University Alliance Program. Its Admission–Training–Placement model combines academic learning with practical training, live projects and career support.
